fact: At the handover of a crime data analysis building to the Buluk police division in Juba, its crime response commander said the unit had had no systematic way of registering, reporting and analysing the information it collects, findings being reported by phone or radio; the building was financed by UNMISS as a Quick Impact Project.
title: UNMISS Police hands over building to serve as a crime data analysis facility to South Sudanese colleagues
publisher: United Nations Mission in South Sudan
